subjects.policy: all three previously explored pilot subjects reserved for training; remaining IDs numerically sorted before seed permutation
subjects.scope: Frozen 31-person expansion; new split does not alter pilot reports

preparation_policy.scope: sleepaccel-cohort-31 only; old pilot manifest/features/deep cache unchanged
preparation_policy.signals: exact complete-row np.unique(axis=0), then ascending original timestamp; no values changed
preparation_policy.label_interval: [first original label timestamp,last original label timestamp+30), including unscored epochs
preparation_policy.remaining_timestamp_conflicts: reject inside label interval after exact-row deduplication; report outside conflicts and crop them explicitly
preparation_policy.labels: strict original _validate_rows reject; no reordering or repair
preparation_policy.missing: no interpolation, averaging or imputation; masks retained
preparation_policy.decision: Main thread approved v3 after complete31 audit found zero conflicting same-timestamp groups within label intervals; no model results used

notes: All previously explored pilot people enter training only; selection independent of labels or results.
